entries.summary: Harvested email classification preferences: constants, rule schema, confidence thresholds, keyword lists, and custom rules
Frozen, ground-truth-verified contract for the five email wrapper binaries: safety classes, global flags, classify pagination, folder-scope query tokens, and the index-freshness gate

Non-negotiable email operating rules: wrapper-only invariant, two-layer enforcement, propose-review-confirm-execute, delete/PATH preconditions, freshness gate, cursor, sub-50 drain, archive gates. On-demand reference only (deliberately not eager-loaded); its own "Role and Loading Model" banner section holds the enforcement-coverage map naming which of the four consumer bodies or which mechanical layer enforces each rule.
Himalaya/notmuch/mbsync layering and account scoping: three folder: query forms (glob-broken, exact-match, regex), unused tag:<account> scheme, per-account liveness/no-silent-fallback rule
notmuch staleness detection: census freshness compares on-disk vs indexed file counts within bounded tolerance, the cross-folder duplicate quirk, reindex-ran marker, and email-reindex remediation
Risk rationale and extra-caution gates for archive-scope (All Mail) operations: blast radius, reversible-vs-hard delete boundary, asymmetric confidence policy, never-auto-sync rule
Consolidated sender/domain bucket approval for whole-mailbox cleanup: min() confidence rollup, 0.90 option-availability gating, multiSelect idiom, residual labeling
Design for routing confirmed skill-email-cleanup classify decisions into sender/domain-aggregated memory-vault preferences (create-once, update/extend)

Complete specification for /email --all mode (whole-mailbox sweep, one consolidated bucket approval, sub-50 transparent drain) -- extracted from skill-email-cleanup/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention
